description: This source file defines the OpenmrsCharacterEscapes class, which customizes JSON character escaping behavior for the Jackson library to escape HTML tags for safety in JSON serialization.

classes.name: OpenmrsCharacterEscapes
classes.description: A subclass of CharacterEscapes that customizes JSON escaping to handle specific characters such as '<' and '>'.

methods.name: OpenmrsCharacterEscapes
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ASCII escape sequences, extending standard JSON escapes to include '<' and '>' characters.

methods.name: getEscapeCodesForAscii
methods.description: Returns the array of escape codes for ASCII characters, including the customized escapes.

methods.name: getEscapeSequence
methods.description: Returns the escape sequence for a given character, specifically converting '<' to '<' and '>' to '>'.
